{"consolidated_memory":"## Flaky Job in CI Pipeline (build/ci/pipeline.yml) — Six Distinct Fixes

Common characteristics: All six incidents involve the same flaky job in the build/ci/pipeline.yml file (build system side). Each exhibits the same signal: one job failing on a minority of runs. All are reproduced by rerunning the same commit ten times. The covering check is the pipeline replay job. Stack is YAML.

### Incident 1: [2026-01-05] Connection Pool Exhaustion
- **Trigger**: Clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- **Root cause**: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- **Fix**: Raised pool ceiling and put bounded wait queue in front of it (PR #1576, branch fix/flaky-job-1)
- **Result**: Cold start dropped 77%, down to 286 ms

### Incident 2: [2026-04-07] Off-by-One in Slice Bound
- **Trigger**: After rolling restart of the fleet
- **Root cause**: Off-by-one in the slice bound
- **Fix**: Corrected the bound and added property test (PR #3957, branch fix/flaky-job-2)
- **Result**: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 35 days running

### Incident 3: [2026-05-05] Race in Lazy Initialisation
- **Trigger**: Records carrying non-ASCII names
- **Root cause**: Race in lazy initialisation
- **Fix**: Guarded the init with double-checked lock (PR #7755, branch fix/flaky-job-3)
- **Result**: Job finished in 11 minutes instead of 6 hours

### Incident 4: [2026-06-21] Serialiser Dropping Unknown Fields
- **Trigger**: First request after cold start
- **Root cause**: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- **Fix**: Switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields (PR #8464, branch fix/flaky-job-4)
- **Result**: Backlog cleared 48 minutes after deploy

### Incident 5: [2026-08-20] Unbounded Retry Loop
- **Trigger**: Sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- **Root cause**: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- **Fix**: Capped attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter (PR #9323, branch fix/flaky-job-5)
- **Result**: p99 latency fell from 1.2 s to 323 ms
- **Note**: Same corner of build/ci/pipeline.yml as earlier flaky job work; context carried over

### Incident 6: [2026-08-23] Error Swallowed by Bare Except
- **Trigger**: Accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- **Root cause**: Error swallowed by bare except
- **Fix**: Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate (PR #9444, branch fix/flaky-job-6)
- **Result**: Flaky test went from 3 failures per 100 runs to zero"}
